info.name: QA-19 MANUAL — SUITE 13 — STAGING
info.description:
SUITE 13: Submissions — 84 cases. Run all folders in order against LOCAL only. Each case creates isolated assignments/modules/submissions through public APIs. Failed fixture setup records a failure and skips the dependent HTTP request. Exact time equality/concurrency are NOT claimed: BE18-19/31 are sequential, BE18-24A/B check outside-window. BE18-07 accepts a genuine expired JWT or creates a locally signed expired fixture only after verifying localJwtSigningSecret against a live backend-issued JWT and verifying the live token succeeds. Never use this development key outside LOCAL. Supply local login credentials in environment; collection contains no credentials. Cleanup soft-deletes only tracked assignments and deletes temporary users. Submission rows and fixture classes remain due to lack of public purge API, but fresh assignments avoid attempt-limit contamination. Existing gradedModuleId must refer to a student-owned GRADED module. Missing BE18-37/38 are reserved IDs; Qase mapping is preserved. HTTP 0/-1=404, IN_PROGRESS detail=200 and wrong-method=403 reflect current backend, not proposed REST changes. Backend currently has error/message but no stable error code; tests validate status and body without inventing error codes.

QA-19 staging adapter: execute through run-all-suites.mjs with run-owned actors/IDs. Original seed identities are replaced at runtime; no local signing key permitted.
QA-19 REGRESSION SCOPE: logout cleanup omitted; logout-dependent cases BLOCKED under BUG-AUTH-STAGING-SEED-LOGOUT-500. All other API and fixture-deletion expectations remain unchanged.
Fixture revision: QA19-fixtures-2026-10-10-v3. Validation/permission expectations unchanged.
POSTMAN IMPORT EDITION: run entire collection, 1 iteration, selected matching SUITE staging environment. CONTROL setup/cleanup is embedded; no Node runner required.
